rows.grounds: purpose of the chanting; compound mantra-su-siddhi.
refers to the peg as prepared.
prior action of blending or merging.

items.question: How must the peg be employed to secure the accomplishment of the mantra?
premises: The peg is to be joined and blended.
The prepared peg is the object of chanting.
Chanting is performed for mantra accomplishment.
items.inference: Chanting the joined and blended peg secures the accomplishment of the mantra.
uncertainties: The precise ritual sense of saṃlopya in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Let him chant that peg, having joined and blended it, for the accomplishment of the mantra.
